Game Overview

At its heart, Scars is a racing game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Scars keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Scars?

Scars is a free racing game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Scars free to play?

Yes, Scars is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
